shellCommands.command: git diff && ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100

cd /workspace; for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore app/*; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; echo; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -n -A40 "Reusing data with" 01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md | head -120; grep -rn "loading.tsx\|loading.js" 01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md | head -20
cd /workspace && git rm -q app/loading.tsx && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30
f=$(ls .next/server/app/index.html) && grep -o '<main>.*</main>' $f | head -c 1500; echo; git status --short
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short
